header.title: Scroll Area
header.description: A box with a limited height or width that scrolls its content with a native scrollbar styled with gem-system tokens. Use it for lists, side panels or text blocks that must keep a fixed size without growing the page. To scroll, the box needs a limit: `height`, `maxHeight` or its container's height.

paragraphs: ScrollArea is a constrained viewport with a token-styled native scrollbar. Height and width come from props or the parent flex or grid track.
The thumb uses a translucent text color on a transparent track and gets darker on hover.
Vertical is the default orientation. Horizontal clips the unused axis so the pane only moves in the direction you chose.
Type auto shows the bar when content overflows. Always reserves the bar's space. Hover shows it on hover or focus. Hidden scrolls without a visible bar.
Pass a label when the box is a named region so screen readers announce it. The scrollable node is the root, so a ref can call scrollTo.
Pair it with Card or List when a panel must keep a fixed height while the rest of the page doesn't grow.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result and code instantly. With `horizontal` and `both` the content is wider than the box so the horizontal bar shows up.
playground.label: Example region

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: With `maxHeight`, the box grows with its content up to that limit and then scrolls. `label` gives the region an accessible name. The examples use this content and these demo styles.
base.label: Sample text

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: `orientation="horizontal"` scrolls left to right and clips the vertical axis. The content must be wider than the box: here the row uses `width: max-content`. `maxWidth="100%"` keeps the box from growing past its container.

both.title: Both axes
both.description: `orientation="both"` scrolls in both directions. Useful for wide tables, code or diagrams: the content must exceed the box's height and width.
both.label: Wide sheet

types.title: Scrollbar visibility
types.description: `type` sets when the bar is visible: `auto` (default) shows it only on overflow, `always` always reserves its space so content doesn't shift, `hover` shows it on hover or focus, and `hidden` hides it while wheel, touch and keyboard scrolling keep working. Each box has `tabIndex={0}` so you can try `hover` with Tab.

sizes.title: Scrollbar thickness
sizes.description: `size` sets the bar thickness: `sm` (4px), `md` (6px, default) or `lg` (8px). Firefox doesn't allow choosing the thickness: it uses its thin bar with the `scrollbar-color` colors.

height.title: height or maxHeight
height.description: `height` fixes the height even when content is short, leaving empty space. `maxHeight` adapts to the content and only scrolls when it exceeds the limit. A number is read as pixels and a string as CSS (`"50vh"`, `"20rem"`). If a child has a background and must cover the whole box, give it `min-height: 100%` instead of `height: 100%`, because with `height` the background gets cut off when scrolling.

fillParent.title: Fill the available space
fillParent.description: In a layout with header and footer, make the container `flex flex-col` with a height and give the ScrollArea `flex-1 min-h-0`: it takes the remaining space and scrolls inside. Without `min-h-0`, the flex child won't shrink and pushes the footer out of the box.

scrollTo.title: Controlling the scroll
scrollTo.description: The `ref` points to the scrolling element, so you can call `scrollTo` or read `scrollTop` directly. `onScroll` is passed to the root, and here it computes the scrolled percentage. With `tabIndex={0}` the box can be focused and scrolled with the arrow keys.

mobile.title: Small screens
mobile.description: On touch screens scrolling works with your finger. `overscroll-behavior: contain` keeps the page from scrolling when you reach the end of the box. `size="lg"` makes the bar a bit more visible.
mobile.label: Text on a small screen

header.title: ScrollArea API
header.description: API reference for the ScrollArea React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens, utilities and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath, which also exports `toCssLength`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTML attributes (HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>) and forwards them to the root element, which is also the scrolling one: ref, onScroll and tabIndex land there. height, maxHeight, width and maxWidth are written to style and merged with the style you pass. There are no inner elements: children render directly in the root.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.label: label is applied as aria-label. Use it when the box is a region with its own name.
a11y.focus: The root isn't focusable by default. If the content has no interactive elements, add tabIndex={0} so it can be scrolled with the keyboard.
a11y.keyboard: With focus inside, arrow keys, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End and the space bar use the browser's native scrolling.
a11y.hidden: With type="hidden" there's no visual hint that there's more content. Show some cue (a gradient or text) so it's noticeable.
a11y.landmark: With as you can render nav, aside, section or main instead of a <div>.
a11y.motion: If you use scrollTo with behavior: "smooth", respect prefers-reduced-motion for people who prefer less animation.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root element and the scrolling one. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Has `overscroll-behavior: contain`.
rules.orientation: Applied according to `orientation`. Sets which axis scrolls and clips the other.
rules.type: Applied according to `type`. `always` uses `overflow: scroll`, `hover` hides the thumb until hover or focus and `hidden` hides the bar.
rules.thumb: Scrollbar thumb in Chrome, Edge and Safari. Firefox uses `scrollbar-color` with the same variables.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: They're all defined on `.gem-scroll-area` and none are written inline, so you can change them from your own class (`.gem-scroll-area.my-class`) or with Tailwind utilities.

items.--gem-scroll-area-fg: Text color. The thumb color is derived from it.
items.--gem-scroll-area-size: Bar thickness. Set by the `size` class.
items.--gem-scroll-area-radius: Box radius. Set by the `radius` class.
items.--gem-scroll-area-thumb: Thumb color. Defaults to the text color at 28%.
items.--gem-scroll-area-thumb-hover: Thumb color on hover. Defaults to the text color at 45%.

items.--gem-color-fg: Text color and base of the thumb color.

items.toCssLength: Turns a number into pixels (`240` → `"240px"`) and leaves strings as they are. It's what `height`, `maxHeight`, `width` and `maxWidth` use.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of the root element.

items.orientation: Axis that scrolls. The other is clipped; `both` allows both.
items.type: When the bar is visible: only on overflow, always, on hover or never.
items.height: Fixed height. A number is read as pixels and a string as CSS.
items.maxHeight: Max height: grows with the content up to this limit.
items.width: Fixed width. A number is read as pixels and a string as CSS.
items.maxWidth: Max width. Useful with `horizontal` or `both` to stay within the container.
items.label: Region accessible name (`aria-label`).
items.className: Extra classes for the root element.
items.classNames: Per-slot classes. `root` is added to the root element.
items.style: Inline styles. Merged with the height and width from props.
items.ref: Ref to the scrolling element. Use it to call `scrollTo`.
